gen-gf-turret-road-gf-wix-madefor-displa: Round, pen-drawn, commanding: Turret Road looks inked in one confident line. Wix Madefor Display sits beneath with gently flared curve ends that stay apart, a contemporary voice that never competes.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-zalando-sans-expan: Punchy and flat-drawn, Turret Road has round, parenthesis-like curves and no shading at all, a heading with real weight. Zalando Sans Expanded needs a bit more size, or its wide gaps scatter.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-zcool-xiaowei: ZCOOL XiaoWei moves gently from stem to serif in weight, a quiet foil to the unshaded, pen-like lines of Turret Road. Quiet modulation against flat, steady lines is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Maru Gothic reads like following a single thread, never snagging on a closed-up bowl, under Turret Road's round, bold lettering. One shouts in pen-like curves, the other murmurs along.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-alan-sans: Horseshoe-wide curves of uniform weight make Underdog loud and expressive. Alan Sans handles the polite part, keeping its curve tails well back from the body so text stays easygoing.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-almarai: Underdog bends a wide horseshoe of a c and never shifts weight along a curve, expressive and commanding. And Almarai holds a line width that never swells or tapers, with letters that never pinch shut.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-andika: Andika reads professional and modern, with wide, easy turns on every s. Underdog, with its horseshoe c and curves of uniform weight, supplies the volume while Andika's sturdy tails keep things grounded.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-anta: Expressive and loud, Underdog flings a horseshoe c over curves of constant weight. Anta brings a wire-bent sign look of constant thickness, its gaping e mouths a natural match for that open c.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-assistant: Open-mouthed letters keep the body text easygoing and contemporary throughout. Assistant stays modest while Underdog's constant-wall o rings loudest at a large size, and shrunk, it loses its stance.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-biz-udgothic: Loud and unshaded, Underdog has no tilted stress in its round letters. BIZ UDGothic gives every bowl a wide channel, so the quieter text keeps pace with that horseshoe-open c.
